SELECT s.id subject_id,count(DISTINCT b.id) FILTER(WHERE q.id IS NOT NULL) bank_count,count(q.id) question_count, count(f.question_id) answered_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='CORRECT') correct_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='WRONG') wrong_count FROM subject s LEFT JOIN question_bank b ON b.subject_id=s.id AND b.status='ACTIVE' AND b.publication_status='PUBLISHED' LEFT JOIN question q ON q.bank_id=b.id AND q.status='ACTIVE' LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.question_id=q.id AND f.rn=1 WHERE s.id IN GROUP BY s.id

SELECT b.id bank_id,s.name subject_name,count(q.id) question_count,count(q.id) FILTER(WHERE q.status='ACTIVE') active_question_count, count(f.question_id) answered_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='CORRECT') correct_count,count(f.question_id) FILTER(WHERE f.judgment='WRONG') wrong_count0 answered_count,0 correct_count,0 wrong_count FROM question_bank b JOIN subject s ON s.id=b.subject_id LEFT JOIN question q ON q.bank_id=b.id LEFT JOIN facts f ON f.question_id=q.id AND f.rn=1 WHERE b.id IN GROUP BY b.id,s.name
SELECT a.id,a.bank_id,coalesce(m.college_id,a.college_id) college_id,a.major_id,a.enrollment_year FROM bank_audience a LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id=a.major_id WHERE a.bank_id IN ORDER BY a.id

mapper.sql: FROM question q JOIN question_revision r ON r.id=q.current_revision_id JOIN question_bank b ON b.id=q.bank_id JOIN subject s ON s.id=b.subject_id WHERE q.status='ACTIVE' AND b.status='ACTIVE' AND b.publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND s.status='ACTIVE' AND (position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(r.stem))>0 OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_option o WHERE o.revision_id=r.id AND position(lower(#{keyword}) in lower(o.content))>0))
